    c. descriptive

# Loop over input items and add a new field called 'my_new_field' to the JSON of each one
import pandas as pd
import json

# 1. Retrieve all incoming items from the previous node
raw_items = _items

# 2. Extract the 'json' dictionary from each n8n item object
json_data = [item["json"] for item in raw_items]

# 3. Create the Pandas DataFrame
df = pd.DataFrame(json_data)
df_10 = df.head(5)

# 4. Convert back to n8n format while PRESERVING item tracking metadata
output = []
for index, row in df_10.iterrows():
    output.append({
        "json": row.to_dict(),
        "pairedItem": {
            "item": index  # This tells downstream nodes exactly which original item this belongs to
        }
    })

return output
